written: 2026-11-05, before any v12 job and before the v10 and v11 results
reason: Every round so far was judged on val fold 0, so the v8 and v10 winners may be partly fitted to that fold. Folds 1 to 4 are untouched by any selection.

recipes.B: the recipe in outputs/ablations/v11_recipe.json: mosaic_p 0.5, heavy_p from the v10 outcome

design: ResNet-50 + ConvNeXt-S + Swin-T per recipe, fixed stop (12, 9, 12), no selection on val, trained on split_v1_fold{1..4}, fused mean probability on the orig view by robust_eval on that fold's val, default + extended + stress suites. Seed 42 for all folds, then seeds 7, 123, 11, 2026, 99, 5, 17, 31 and 8 while time remains (seed list extended before any v12 job so the GPU stays in use until the deadline).
stop: no new job after the deadline in gpu_deadline.txt. All complete fold and seed pairs are used; nothing is rerun to change a result.

rule.metric: paired B minus A over complete fold and seed pairs: clean, worst-of-23, pixelate8, stress mean
rule.keep_B: mean clean gain >= -0.003 and mean pixelate8 gain > 0
rule.otherwise: refit recipe A on all labelled rows, same seeds and fixed stop, and ship that instead of the v11 bundle

reporting: the mean over folds of recipe B is the cross-validated estimate quoted in the report, next to fold 0.
limits: Fixed-stop models trained on 80% of the data, so the estimate is for that size, not for the refit. Fold 0 is excluded from the comparison because it took part in selection.
never: test images in any statistic or training

results.status: final: folds 1-3 seed 42 scored for both recipes; fold 4 recipe A scored, recipe B trained but not scored; stopped at the deadline (8 Nov 15:30), no further seeds
